intro.text: The Origin of Storms: the place where, ancient myths say, every highstorm begins.

description.text: Stormwardens today think a single highstorm circles the world without end, but humans and Parshendi alike still speak of the Origin, and many believe the storms begin there. Lirin says the few ships that set out to sail east to it never returned.

A Natan named Puuli and his grandfather believe people live on a hidden island at the Origin: sailors lost on the Ocean of Origins who will return with Light in their pockets and restore the fallen kingdom of Natanatan.
Urithiru, built above the storms, has a tall column of windows facing straight toward the Origin, so it can be seen from many rooms of the tower, including the great atrium.

Because highstorms are strongest in the east, where they make landfall, most buildings there put their doors, balconies and gardens on the side facing away from the Origin, and people can feel uneasy in rooms that face it. Some, such as Dalinar and Eshonai, often look toward it to think.
